about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Mark Alford

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AGOA EXTENSION ACT
statements.title: AGOA EXTENSION ACT
sentences: Last year, Senate Democrats manufactured a 42-day shutdown that punished troops, farmers, veterans, and working families.
Rural hospitals and local law enforcement felt the hit, and Missouri families paid the price for Washington games.
I rise in strong support of this continuing resolution.
We will not let that happen again.
That is why, Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to pass this resolution to keep the government open and then finish the appropriations work the Constitution actually requires of us here in Congress.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
statements.title: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
sentences: When I came to Congress, I made it quite clear: We should not be trading individual stocks while we are making decisions that shape our economy.
That is why I introduced the PELOSI Act to draw a bright, unmistakable line, no stock trading, no gray area, and no doubt, to be above the appearance of impropriety as Chairman Steil said.

If I wanted to, I could have made a lot of money in the last 3\1/2\ years I was here trading stock and probably would be able to afford an apartment somewhere in D.C. However, I don't, and like a lot of Members who don't trade stocks, I sleep on my couch in my office.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: It also demands fiscal responsibility.

It strengthens oversight of taxpayer dollars, especially, with new accountability for grant programs, to make sure that taxpayer dollars are not spent on woke projects, like a transgender opera in Colombia.
When we do spend abroad, it should serve American interests, supporting our allies like Israel and Taiwan.
Mr. Chairman, I rise in support of this fiscal year 2027 National Security, Department of State, and Related Programs funding bill.
That is why I strongly urge its support.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SMALL BUSINESS TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCEMENT ACT
statements.title: SMALL BUSINESS TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCEMENT ACT
sentences: Cloud-based accounting systems, payroll platforms, cybersecurity tools, inventory management software, and emerging artificial intelligence applications are not optional any longer if you are going to succeed in small business.
I rise today in support of passing the Small Business Technological Advancement Act through the House.

If we want Main Street to compete in a modern digital economy, our laws must reflect that reality, and that is why I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' for the Small Business Technological Advancement Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: This legislation also reinforces national security by addressing the rising crisis of foreign ownership of U.S. agricultural land while also strengthening oversight of critical supply chains.
Madam Chair, I rise today in strong support of our Agriculture, Rural Development, Food and Drug, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act.
Madam Chair, I urge all my colleagues to get behind this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: It means access to care, expanded mental health services, and continued investment in suicide prevention.
We are also strengthening the Community Care program, giving veterans more flexibility to get the specialized care they need when and where they need it.

For our servicemembers and military families, this bill invests in what matters most: safe housing, better barracks, childcare facilities that improve everyday life, and the quality of care that we have been talking about in this Congress.
We are ensuring veterans' Second Amendment rights are not undermined while stopping taxpayer dollars from going to Communist China.
I urge my colleagues to join us in what we did in our committee.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL JUBILEE OF PRAYER, PRAISE, AND THANKSGIVING
statements.title: NATIONAL JUBILEE OF PRAYER, PRAISE, AND THANKSGIVING
sentences: If we ever forget that we are one nation under God, we will be a nation gone under.'' Mr. Speaker, that spirit, that spirit of a people who place their trust in Providence, is worth preserving with all of our hearts.

So as this National Jubilee is observed, I urge every American, everyone in this room, in the gallery watching today, watching tonight, I urge every American to take a moment to thank God Almighty for the blessings that we have received, the sacred responsibilities that we all carry no matter if you are Democrat or Republican, and the kind of country, that shining city upon that hill, we want to pass on to our children and our grandchildren.
Mr. Speaker, as I close tonight, I will tell everyone in this room, our Nation needs healing.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
statements.title: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
sentences: I wrongly laughed out loud when I heard him say in the well of the floor of the House of Representatives: ``Yes, we will always support securing the border--today, tomorrow, and forever.'' It was an uncontrollable laugh.

This is what started all of this: an administration that did not care about securing our border and the Democrats who backed him up, along with Alejandro Mayorkas, who let 15 million illegal aliens into our great Nation to cause chaos, not to be a part of the fabric of America but to tear apart the fabric of America.
I will quote the ranking member from a press release January 20, the gentlewoman from Connecticut (Ms. DeLauro), my good friend: ``The Homeland Security funding bill is more than just ICE.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: These bills strengthen our military, secure our border, invest in health and workforce readiness, modernize transportation, and deliver real savings for taxpayers.
This Homeland bill makes us safer at home by deporting illegal criminal aliens.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AI FOR MAIN STREET ACT
statements.title: AI FOR MAIN STREET ACT
sentences: Whether it is managing inventory, scheduling workers, marketing products, improving cybersecurity, or streamlining paperwork, artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming how business gets done in America.

The AI for Main Street Act directs Small Business Development Centers, SBDCs, to provide counseling, training, and outreach to help small businesses safely evaluate and adopt artificial intelligence tools.
Just as importantly, this bill emphasizes responsible adoption.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in strong support of our AI for Main Street Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT AND NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT AND NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Chairman Diaz-Balart delivered DOGE-era USAID cuts while still funding national security investments.
We fully fund CFIUS to stop foreign threats from buying up America, keep longstanding pro-life protections in place, and deliver a bill with no poison pills.
Mr. Chairman, today we are voting on a two-bill appropriations package that funds Financial Services and our National Security and State Department.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: It strengthens our national security, restores American energy dominance, backs law enforcement, combats illicit drugs, and supports responsible land management, all while spending less than the current continuing resolution.
There are several investments that I won't go into here, but I am proud of this process.
Mr. Speaker, I urge passage of this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4593, SAVING HOMEOWNERS FROM OVERREGULATION WITH EXCEPTIONAL RINSING ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 5184, AFFORDABLE H
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4593, SAVING HOMEOWNERS FROM OVERREGULATION WITH EXCEPTIONAL RINSING ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 5184, AFFORDABLE HOUSING OVER MANDATING EFFICIENCY...
sentences: When Washington piles on blue tape mandates and bureaucratic nonsense, working families pay the price.
Mr. Speaker, I urge passage of the rule.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SMALL BUSINESS REGULATORY REDUCTION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SMALL BUSINESS REGULATORY REDUCTION ACT OF 2025
sentences: This legislation supports President Trump's regulatory rightsizing agenda and gives our job creators the relief they desperately need to start, to grow, and to succeed once again.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 2965, the Small Business Regulatory Reduction Act of 2025.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DENOUNCING THE HORRORS OF SOCIALISM
statements.title: DENOUNCING THE HORRORS OF SOCIALISM
sentences: It crushes religious liberty and destroys free markets.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Tonight, Mr. Speaker, we will reopen the government and liberate the Schumer hostages.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: It also ensures the Trump administration can continue its work to secure our border, secure our communities from violent crime, and secure a stronger economy.
As you will see throughout this debate today, Democrats' proposal is full of partisan priorities that would explode the Federal debt by $1.5 trillion.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of this short-term CR, the continuing resolution.
That is why, Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the continuing resolution and keep our government open.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: They would be voting against a pay raise for American troops and border security investments to counter drug trafficking.

They would be voting against increased stability for servicemembers and their families, against training and equipment for an agile, capable force, against supporting the supply chain production, against deterring the Chinese Communist Party and foreign adversaries, and voting to prevent taxpayer dollars from funding abortion travel.
I rise in strong support today of H.R. 4016, the Defense appropriations bill before us, not just as a matter of policy, but as a matter of preparedness.

Mr. Chair, for their sake, for our sake, for the sake of our great Nation, I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support this bill, to deliver on our America First agenda with President Trump and to stand firm in our commitment to peace through strength.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: H.R. 1 protects the 87,000 Missouri farms and countless family-owned small businesses from double taxation by expanding the death tax exemption.
The One Big Beautiful Bill Act reverses 4 long years of Biden's open- border policies with a generational investment in border security, including funding to complete phase 2 of the border wall.
H.R. 1 ends the progressive left's war on American energy by unleashing domestic oil, natural gas, and nuclear energy production.
Finally, H.R. 1 restores fiscal sanity by cutting almost $2 trillion in Federal spending.

We can choose to side with the illegal aliens, unelected rogue bureaucrats, and fear-mongering from the America left or we can choose to side with the American people and deliver on the mandate that they gave us back in November.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the rule and in strong support of H.R. 1, President Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to put America first, support the rule, and pass the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAKING A STEP TOWARD TRUE ENERGY DOMINANCE
statements.title: TAKING A STEP TOWARD TRUE ENERGY DOMINANCE
sentences: Honoring the 509th Bomb Wing at Whiteman Air Force Base Mr. Speaker, I rise today with immense pride for the brave airmen of Missouri's own 509th Bomb Wing at Whiteman Air Force Base in my district, who executed decisive, strategic strikes against the Iranian regime under the leadership of President Donald J. Trump.
B-2s launched from Whiteman and executed a long-range strike against Iran in Operation Midnight Hammer.
We prove our dominance on the world stage, and we ensure that regimes like Iran's will never get their hands on a nuclear weapon.
I also will take a moment to honor the other heroes who are part of this historic operation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: This bill delivers to construct and improve military housing, childcare centers, and other quality-of-life components that are so important to those who risk so much.
The bill continues robust investments in women's health, rural health, veterans' homelessness issues, and mental health.
Drone warfare between Ukraine and Russia has shown just how vulnerable strategic assets can be.
We increased access opportunities by increasing the funds available for community care.
This bill does that, and I urge my colleagues to vote for this bill, a vote to support our veterans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAVE SBA FROM SANCTUARY CITIES ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SAVE SBA FROM SANCTUARY CITIES ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 2931, the Save SBA from Sanctuary Cities Act of 2025, championed by my good friend Congressman Finstad.
This is about putting American small business owners first, while ensuring lawless sanctuary cities do not reap the benefits of hosting SBA offices.

This is all about protecting America's small businesses and making sure that Federal taxpayer dollars are not funneled into lawless sanctuary cities that put illegal aliens ahead of their own citizens.

This bill will relocate SBA regional offices from sanctuary jurisdictions to communities that actually respect the rule of law, that actually put American citizens first, and that is not controversial.
President Biden's open-border policies let in millions of illegal aliens, unvetted illegal aliens, including dangerous, violent criminals.

The woke policies of Democrat-run sanctuary cities, fueled by woke politics, have become magnets for chaos, stretching public resources to the brink, and crowding out citizens who actually follow the law.
The Federal Government should not reward sanctuary cities with permanent SBA infrastructure.
In March, SBA Administrator Loeffler announced a series of actions to put Americans first, including moving SBA regional offices out of sanctuary cities.
There are many cities that share the same lawless, woke policies as sanctuary cities.
They are soft on crime, even if they don't wear the sanctuary label outright.
It is not officially designated as a sanctuary city, but it might as well be a first cousin of one.
At the end of the day, American citizens and small businesses should be the ones being served by SBA offices, not illegal aliens in sanctuary cities.
I urge my colleagues to support this legislation and vote ``yes'' for H.R. 2931.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRANSPARENCY AND PREDICTABILITY IN SMALL BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES ACT
statements.title: TRANSPARENCY AND PREDICTABILITY IN SMALL BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES ACT
sentences: They are the innovators, the job creators, the backbone of our communities, and the heartbeat of Main Street America.

Here is what is happening: When a Federal agency determines they have a need for certain products or services, then that agency's acquisition personnel will post a solicitation on the Federal Government's SAM.gov website for a contract to fill the requirements.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 789, the Transparency and Predictability in Small Business Opportunities Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support the Transparency and Predictability in Small Business Opportunities Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: It protects Medicaid for our citizens by removing more than a million illegal aliens from taxpayer-funded benefits.
Yes, Mr. Speaker, this draws the clear line: No taxpayer dollars for sex change surgeries for anyone.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``yes'' vote on this big, beautiful bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WINNERS OF THE CONGRESSIONAL SPEECH COMPETITION
statements.title: WINNERS OF THE CONGRESSIONAL SPEECH COMPETITION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I will continue at a later date with our remaining winners.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
statements.title: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
sentences: If you travel the Fourth District of the great State of Missouri, just south of Reverend Cleaver's district in Kansas City, and you ask the average person, Mr. Speaker, if Members of Congress should be able to trade individual stocks, they will say no.
If you want to trade stocks, then go to Wall Street.
That is what we should be here about, not trying to get rich on trading stocks.
Unfortunately, too many Members of Congress are engaging in suspicious stock trades based on nonpublic information to enrich themselves.
These gross violations of the public trust make it clear: We must finally take action and take a stand to ban Members and their spouses from owning or selling individual stocks.

The reason we introduced this is because there have been widespread reports of suspicious transactions associated with public officials and it raises a lot of concerns about what we are doing here in this great body.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FULL-YEAR CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2025
statements.title: FULL-YEAR CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2025
sentences: They are causing chaos, spreading mistruths, and doing everything they can to disrupt what the American people voted for, all because they cannot accept that their Big Government, open-border, America-last agenda is over.
We are passing a continuing resolution to keep America open for business, freeze wasteful spending, and secure our border.
Leave the rabbit in the backyard alone.
Mr. Speaker, I will just preface my remarks by saying how much respect I have for the ranking member and her passionate arguments.
I urge progressive Democrats to join the rest of the Nation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUCCESSFUL ENTREPRENEURSHIP FOR RESERVISTS AND VETERANS ACT
statements.title: SUCCESSFUL ENTREPRENEURSHIP FOR RESERVISTS AND VETERANS ACT
sentences: As a result, my colleague Representative Sharice Davids and I introduced the Successful Entrepreneurship for Reservists and Veterans, or the SERV Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all of my colleagues to support this commonsense legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong and unwavering support for protecting women, protecting women's sports, and passing H.R. 28, the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.

Women have been stripped of their earned titles and live in fear for their safety in the locker rooms of America, women like Riley Gaines, Lily Mullens, Paula Scanlan, and so many others with unspoken stories.
The Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act clarifies the protections under Title IX and ensures our women can continue to compete in fair and secure environments.
Men have no business competing in women's sports or being in their locker rooms.
